items.name: Finsupp.weight_single
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (s : σ) (r : R) : ((Finsupp.weight w) fun₀ | s => r) = r • w s
